॥ Om, and there is no need for inference. Om ॥ 1/1/18 ॥

Nor is there any contradiction with specific inferences. And there is no need for inference, as one can infer as one wishes. Therefore, no separate inference is required for the ultimate reality. It is also stated in the Skanda Purana: “Because one can infer as one wishes, this is not a matter of inference; it is done to avoid contradiction between the earlier and later parts of the Veda, and not otherwise anywhere.” And it is also said: “This understanding cannot be attained through reasoning.” ॥ 18 ॥
